$description: oneMK design tokens, written by scripts/brand-tokens.py from crates/app/src/style.rs (the source of truth; do not edit by hand). Dark UI is primary. Volt is the only signal colour: use it for the pointer, live state and the one primary action, never for decoration. Translucent colours are straight (not premultiplied) rgba.

room.description: The room the desk stands in: the window's ground behind everything.

sidebar.description: The sidebar: solid, a step lighter than the room, a hairline at its edge.

hairline.description: The sidebar: solid, a step lighter than the room, a hairline at its edge.

side-chosen.description: The chosen page in the sidebar, and a row under the pointer.

side-chosen-edge.description: The chosen page in the sidebar, and a row under the pointer.

side-hover.description: The chosen page in the sidebar, and a row under the pointer.

elevated-top.description: A raised surface over the desk (the panels, the toolbar): solid, a little lighter at the top, edged by a hairline.

elevated.description: A raised surface over the desk (the panels, the toolbar): solid, a little lighter at the top, edged by a hairline.

elevated-edge.description: A raised surface over the desk (the panels, the toolbar): solid, a little lighter at the top, edged by a hairline.

palette-top.description: The command palette's glass: dark enough that what is behind it is colour, not detail.

palette.description: The command palette's glass: dark enough that what is behind it is colour, not detail.

search-fill.description: The search row at the top of the sidebar.

shortcut-ink.description: Shortcut keys beside each page: quiet, yet 4.5:1 on the sidebar and on its chosen row.

room-tint.description: The room on a see-through window (macOS): a dark tint over the blurred desktop, 88% so grey text keeps 4.5:1 even over a white wallpaper.

glass-top.description: Glass, frosted: over its blurred backdrop, a little white (more at the top, as if lit from above) over a little dark, so a panel reads lighter than the room yet keeps text at 4.5:1 over the brightest backdrop. `GLASS_TOP` at the top, `GLASS` at the bottom (premultiplied).

glass.description: Glass, frosted: over its blurred backdrop, a little white (more at the top, as if lit from above) over a little dark, so a panel reads lighter than the room yet keeps text at 4.5:1 over the brightest backdrop. `GLASS_TOP` at the top, `GLASS` at the bottom (premultiplied).

glass-clear-top.description: The same on a see-through window, where the room under the panel is already a dark tint: less dark, the same frost.

glass-clear.description: The same on a see-through window, where the room under the panel is already a dark tint: less dark, the same frost.

glass-solid-top.description: Without blur (old OpenGL, or reduce transparency): solid.

glass-solid.description: Without blur (old OpenGL, or reduce transparency): solid.

control-top.description: A control's glass (a button, the chosen segment): clearer than a panel's, a little lighter.

control.description: A control's glass (a button, the chosen segment): clearer than a panel's, a little lighter.

control-solid-top.description: A control's glass (a button, the chosen segment): clearer than a panel's, a little lighter.

control-solid.description: A control's glass (a button, the chosen segment): clearer than a panel's, a little lighter.

group.description: The content layer (settings groups, Health, the keys): a quiet fill and a hairline, no glass. Opaque, so what sits on it reads the same over any backdrop.

group-edge.description: The content layer (settings groups, Health, the keys): a quiet fill and a hairline, no glass. Opaque, so what sits on it reads the same over any backdrop.

track.description: A segmented control's track, and the chosen segment's capsule. Opaque: the chosen capsule is 3:1 on the track and ink on it 4.5:1.

thumb.description: A segmented control's track, and the chosen segment's capsule. Opaque: the chosen capsule is 3:1 on the track and ink on it 4.5:1.

track-line.description: The edge of what you act on (a segmented track, a field, a switch that is off): 3:1 on the group and on the raised panels.

field-edge.description: The edge of what you act on (a segmented track, a field, a switch that is off): 3:1 on the group and on the raised panels.

field-edge-lit.description: The edge of what you act on (a segmented track, a field, a switch that is off): 3:1 on the group and on the raised panels.

switch-edge.description: The edge of what you act on (a segmented track, a field, a switch that is off): 3:1 on the group and on the raised panels.

switch-off.description: A switch that is off, and under the pointer.

switch-off-lit.description: A switch that is off, and under the pointer.

control-edge.description: The hairline round a solid control.

glass-hairline.description: The edge of a glass shape where the light doesn't catch it.

glass-rim.description: A glass panel's rim, and its lit top edge (drawn when there is no blur; with blur the glass lights its own rim).

glass-edge.description: A glass panel's rim, and its lit top edge (drawn when there is no blur; with blur the glass lights its own rim).

popover.description: What floats over everything (a sheet, a toast, a menu): solid, so it reads the same whatever is under it and while it moves.

on-glass-lit.description: A control or a chosen row on glass: a little lighter than the glass.

panel.description: The gap round and between panels.

raised.description: Wells and fields on glass: a touch lighter than what is under them.

line.description: Hairlines: the ink at 7%, so they sit on glass and on solid alike.

ink.description: Hairlines: the ink at 7%, so they sit on glass and on solid alike.

ink2.description: Hairlines: the ink at 7%, so they sit on glass and on solid alike.

ink3.description: Labels and quiet numbers on glass: 4.5:1 over any backdrop.

ink-hover.description: Between INK2 and INK: hovered labels.

signal.description: Volt, the brand's one signal colour (the lit tip of the oneMK pointer): something crossing, a drop target, the main action, the pointer on the desk, keyboard focus.

accent.description: The accent for chosen and on states (a switch that is on): Volt too.

accent-lit.description: The accent for chosen and on states (a switch that is on): Volt too.

signal-lit.description: The accent for chosen and on states (a switch that is on): Volt too.

warn.description: Not smooth (a slow or stalling connection, lost packets): warm amber, short of an error, and never the brand's Volt, which means good things.

lamp.description: The desk lamp's warm light in the room.

ok.description: Connected: a dot, never words alone.

button.description: Quiet buttons, and the pill under the chosen tab or segment.

button-lit.description: Quiet buttons, and the pill under the chosen tab or segment.

pill.description: Quiet buttons, and the pill under the chosen tab or segment.

track-off.description: A switch that is off: a visible track with a 3:1 edge.

track-edge.description: A switch that is off: a visible track with a 3:1 edge.

key-edge.description: The outline of a drawn key or mouse button: 3:1 on the panel and on the key's own fill.

off.description: Things that are off or offline, still 3:1 on the panel.

panel.description: Corners: panels, things inside them, small controls.

inner.description: Corners: panels, things inside them, small controls.

group.description: A group of rows on glass (settings).

gap.description: The gap round and between panels.

title.description: Panel titles and the sheet title.

line-height.description: Paragraph line height, as a multiple of the size.
